latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — provides expert-guided Datadog monitor design with SLO and tier template support.

- Designs monitors to reduce false positives and alert fatigue, using SLO-based multi-window burn-rate alerts.
- Recommends optimal Datadog monitor types: threshold, anomaly, forecast, outlier, composite, etc., based on use case.
- Integrates tag-driven routing, downtime scheduling, and notification message engineering with runbook linking.
- Outputs ready-to-import Datadog monitor JSON and structured notification/message templates.
- Includes workflows for pruning noisy monitors, mapping SLOs to alerts, and establishing per-tier monitor packs.
